LY-294002 may indirectly inhibit CDK9, affecting RNA Pol II and histone acetylation; donor flavopiridol (CDK9 inhibitor) could mimic H3K27ac1K36me2 loss.
LY-294002 may activate JNK stress signaling; donor SP600125 (JNK inhibitor) could oppose or modulate similar histone mark changes.
LY-294002 may inhibit ATM/DNA-PK-related pathways; donor KU-55933 (ATM inhibitor) may produce overlapping histone modification profiles.
LY-294002 may inhibit DOT1L via PI3K/AKT cross-talk; donor EPZ-5676 (DOT1L inhibitor) could replicate H3K36 methylation changes.
